mapper.select: SELECT o.`id` AS order_id, o.`voucher_id`, v.`shop_id`, s.`name` AS shop_name, v.`title`, v.`sub_title`, v.`rules`, v.`pay_value`, v.`actual_value`, v.`type`, sv.`stock`, sv.`begin_time`, sv.`end_time`, o.`status` AS order_status, o.`create_time`, o.`pay_time`, o.`use_time`, o.`update_time` FROM tb_voucher_order o INNER JOIN tb_voucher v ON o.`voucher_id` = v.`id` LEFT JOIN tb_shop s ON v.`shop_id` = s.`id` LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.`id` = sv.`voucher_id` WHERE o.`user_id` = #{userId} ORDER BY o.`create_time` DESC, o.`id` DESC
